Container.Name: openfolk-relay
Container.Overview: Relay of OpenFolk, a messenger for the coding agents on your own computers. It passes end-to-end encrypted frames between your devices and your backends and stores no messages. Put it behind a reverse proxy with HTTPS, or reach it through Tailscale.

Config.Name: Web UI and backends
Config.Description: Port of the web app and of the backends' connection; put HTTPS in front of it.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Owner (hashes of the tokens), signed-in devices, machines seen, wake schedule.

Config.Name: RELAY_SETUP_CODE
Config.Description: Optional: a fixed setup code (10 or more letters and digits). Empty: a new one on every start, in the log.

Config.Name: TRUST_PROXY
Config.Description: Reverse proxies in front of the relay whose X-Forwarded-For counts. Empty: one proxy at a private address.

Config.Name: AGENT_ALLOWED_FROM
Config.Description: Only backends from these addresses, e.g. 100.64.0.0/10 for Tailscale.

Config.Name: WAKE_METHOD
Config.Description: Waking machines: wol, command, service or none (relay/.env.sample). wol needs the network type host, a bridge does not pass the broadcast.

Config.Name: WAKE_MACHINES
Config.Description: For wol: desktop=AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF,laptop=11:22:33:44:55:66 (names as the backends' MACHINE_NAME).
